resume: Architecture 2 is spent on two independent failures, both measured. Determinism: the judge returned NOT_DETERMINISTIC and SEND_BACK with Gate C and Gate D failing, because clause 9.2 read literally gives PHP 6,000 and the committed method gives 8,000. The clause says the scheme's awards are the awards of all accredited partners AT the award volumes and award levels of the twelve months, and that a band has ONE award level, so under 9.3 a whole cell refers or none of it does: shares run 100.00, 90.08, 51.75, 30.85, 13.38 and 2.90 per cent at 1,000 to 6,000, and that route is immovable across every handling variant the judge tried (dropping a quarter, netting recoveries, double-counting or dropping PRELIM, excluding the withdrawn partner, unweighted and median monthly averages, and every rounding form). A second fork sits inside the committed method: nothing says which awards supply the within-cell shape, and varying only the shape sample moves the deciding share at 7,000 across 4.96 to 7.12 per cent, with the whole shipped portal export landing 0.007 points inside the 6.0 line. Rubric: the isolated reader kept 18 of 30 ask figures for a measured pair of 61.5 against a bar of 50. Both independent threads filed 6,000 from the literal reading, which is why this is a fork rather than a judge quibble. The judge's one-sentence repair, stating that the share is computed on awards taken at band level times the portal distribution for the same twelve months, is declined: it files the HOW, which turns the decisive step into rule application and spends the stump, and CLAUDE.md's first section names that as the way a determinism repair slips past the client's rules. The lesson for the next architecture is that a pin added to close one fork can open a larger one, because clause 9.2 was added in the previous pass to close the grain fork. Gate A passed, every committed figure reproduced, and the judge corrected its own annex figures against the build's rather than the reverse.
